7. voice message if cmd.voice

div.style: color: rgb(44, 62, 80) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Trigger Evaluation Chain
1. -stop/-start/-clear commands
2. self-message guard
3. mention → ALWAYS respond
4. DM → ALWAYS respond
5. global pause check
6. per-channel cooldown
7. name substring match
8. keyword + 10% probability
9. follow-up (bot last, 60s, ≤3)
10. random 1.5% chance
11. ignore (fallback)

div.style: color: rgb(44, 62, 80) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Behavior Engine
Sleep: schedules (null/short/slow/sleep)
Burst: 2-3 fragments @ 15%
Typo: neighbor key replace @ 6%
LetterSwap: adjacent swap @ 4%
Hesitate: prepend word @ 15%
Forget: 3% (not DMs/mentions)
React: random emoji + delay
Voice: flag @ 12%
Delay: reading + warmup + fatigue + jitter
Ignore: base% + sleep bonus + fatigue bonus
ReplyStyle: weighted 50/15/30/5

div.style: color: rgb(44, 62, 80) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
State Management (in-memory)
BrainState:
├── cooldowns (per-channel)
├── activity timestamps
├── session pause/queue
├── lastSpeaker
├── followUp budget (60s, 3 max)
├── botActivity
└── global inactivity timer
TopicFatigue:
├── word repetition logs
├── freq ≥3 → delay mult up to 5x
└── auto-prune
Spontaneous: 5min interval, 12%

div.style: color: rgb(44, 62, 80) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Service Clients
SapphireClient → HTTP :3123
├── askStream() SSE (main path)
├── ask() non-streaming
└── reset(sessionId)
RubyClient → HTTP :3127
├── train() fire-and-forget
└── generate(seed, length, channel)

div.style: color: rgb(44, 62, 80) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Generation Routing
Ruby_reasons includes trigger reason?
→ YES: Ruby.generate() (no LLM)
→ NO: Sapphire.askStream()
First token → TypingCommand
Final → apply typo/swap → RespondCommand

span.p:

/v1/respond → main pipeline
/v1/chat → OpenAI proxy
/classify / /v1/reset
/emotion/{key} / /health

div.style: color: rgb(44, 62, 80) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Centroid Classification
BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (384-dim)
578 futile + 545 interessant centroids
Cosine similarity diff → label

div.style: color: rgb(44, 62, 80) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Emotion Scoring
4 pole centroids (pos/neg/high/low)
Valence/Arousal ∈ [-1,1]
EMA: decay=0.85, deadzone=0.005

div.style: color: rgb(44, 62, 80) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Session Store
In-memory dict, TTL=10min
max_history: 20 exchanges
Java hashCode → slot mapping

div.style: color: rgb(44, 62, 80) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Request Pipeline
embed → classify → score emotion
→ update EMA → pick backend
→ append to session → inject few-shot
→ compute slot → emotion sampling params
→ call Krystal (retry ×3)
→ degenerate check → truncate user leak
→ save to session → respond

div.style: color: rgb(44, 62, 80) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Emotion-Aware Sampling
temperature = 0.7 + arousal×0.3 [0.4, 1.0]
repeat_penalty = 1.15 − valence×0.1 [1.0, 1.3]
mirostat: mode=2, LR=0.1, ent=5.0+arousal×2

div.style: color: rgb(44, 62, 80) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Degenerate Detection
empty / single char / short+noPunct
retry up to 3×
